ROpenSci Review of RAQSAPI todo list

Source: Ropensci Review of RAQSAPI - todo list.md

Ai generated summary of findings from ROpenSci review of RAQSAPI as a todo list of issues that are to be addressed.

Must fix

Status Item Why it matters Source(s) submitter comments
[◪] Fix checkaqsparams() so validation actually runs for the production wrapper calls Right now positional calls appear to skip validation, so invalid inputs may pass silently Milan Malfait (@milanmlft); Rainer M Krug (@rkrug) addressed the issue presented by @milfait but did not implement passing parameters by position; checkaqsparams is a non-exported internal-helperfunction that should not be called directly by the end user, all internal function calls to checkaqsparams pass values by parameter and should not pass values by position so this should not be an issue.
✓ Fix the always-true MA/pqao validation logic in checkaqsparams() The current logical condition would reject valid values if reached Milan Malfait (@milanmlft) addressed in commit 1254e2d
✓ Fix the broken rlang::abort() path in validation The validator appears to fail internally instead of showing the intended error message Milan Malfait (@milanmlft); Rainer M Krug (@rkrug) addressed in commit fbeac72
✓ Fix the S3 validator bug in AQS_DATAMART_APIv2 The second data slot is not being validated correctly Milan Malfait (@milanmlft) addressed in commit a44230d
✓ Remove the Sys.setenv() mutation from .onLoad() and clean up the ineffective save/restore logic in .onUnLoad() Packages should not mutate user session-wide environment settings on load Milan Malfait (@milanmlft) addressed in commit 7828447
✓ Replace the empty / ineffective NEWS.md with a real changelog R CMD check reports no news entries and the file is effectively a stub Milan Malfait (@milanmlft); Rainer M Krug (@rkrug) address in [commit ac2ae90}(https://github.com/USEPA/RAQSAPI/commit/ac2ae9030faa9b916e170258499fc414956af1ca)]
✓ Strengthen tests beyond expect_no_error() smoke tests The current suite can pass even if returned data are wrong Milan Malfait (@milanmlft); Rainer M Krug (@rkrug) When Unit tests are run on any function that hits the API (with the exception of the aqs_sign_up function:
* the checkaqsparams function is called to verify that input parameters to the function called are the correct type, length and have acceptable values
* The aqs function is called which uses the httr2 to make API calls, httr2 uses the jsonlite package to verify that the returned json data is valid, jsonlite then converts the json data to a tibble which has it’s own internal data verification.
* The AQS function throws an error if the API itself returns an error.
* even though unit test pass the result of the call to functions that hit the API directly to testthat::expect_no_error,
it is important to understand that the returned object is a AQSAPIV2 object.
- creating a new AQSAPI_V2 object automatically invokes a call to the internal AQS_DATAMART_APIv2_validator function which verifies the structure of the returned object and throws an error if the object returned is not structured properly, also addressed in commit fbeac72
❓ Add tests for validation failure paths, especially checkaqsparams() This would catch the validation bugs and protect future fixes Milan Malfait (@milanmlft) Please refer to tests/testthat/test-helperfunctions.R#L25-L66
✓ Fix Rd rendering issues such as leaked @seealso, broken math markup, and the misleading aqs_sign_up note These are user-facing documentation defects Milan Malfait (@milanmlft) addressed in commit 1254e2d
✓ Restore or add a proper CONTRIBUTING file Community guidelines are incomplete without it Milan Malfait (@milanmlft); Rainer M Krug (@rkrug) addressed in commit c2f3609
✓ Fix malformed package metadata and validation blockers in DESCRIPTION A bad DESCRIPTION comment/version field caused devtools::check() to fail; metadata hygiene needs cleanup Milan Malfait (@milanmlft); Rainer M Krug (@rkrug) addressed in commit e96994
✓ Regenerate or fix codemeta.json The file is invalid JSON as reviewed Milan Malfait (@milanmlft) addressed in commit e96994f
✓ Fix CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md placeholders and broken links Community files currently contain template leftovers and malformed markdown Milan Malfait (@milanmlft) addressed in commit 9eaa758
✓ Delete stale tests/test-RAQSAPI.R.blob It is obsolete and confusing, even if it does not break checks Milan Malfait (@milanmlft) addressed in e96994f
✓ Fix the broken README badge link The badge URL is malformed Milan Malfait (@milanmlft) addressed in commit 54a8815

Suggested order of attack

  1. Fix validation and error handling bugs.
  2. Repair the S3 validator and session-mutating load hook.
  3. Clean up NEWS.md, DESCRIPTION, Rd rendering, and other packaging issues.
  4. Strengthen tests with real assertions and failure-path checks.
  5. Consolidate vignettes and add at least one runnable example.
  6. Then tackle structural refactoring and dependency reduction.
